def: a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center

name: spit
def: expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth

name: splash
def: a small quantity of something moist or liquid

name: stretching
def: act of expanding by lengthening or widening

name: therapeutic
def: relating to or involved in therapy

name: tomato
def: mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable

name: tub
def: a large open vessel for holding or storing liquids

name: undertaken
def: accept as a challenge

name: utter
def: express audibly; utter sounds (not necessarily words)

name: yell
def: a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
